refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Mode 1 uses the legacy name-based antirush_objectives.cfg rules and g_antirushTime. Mode 2 enables native AutoAdmin rules from antirush/antirush.cfg and antirush/maps/MAP.cfg. The protected duration is a configurable fraction of the map timelimit, excluding pauses. Trickplant areas remain active throughout the match. Native rules do not require Lua or game logs.

Use !aa or /aa for the objective editor and !antirush status/on/off for native mode management. Both commands use the admin system, its help and logs, and require g_admin 1. Player access requires an authenticated internal Xmod GUID and C/aa or C/antirush respectively; configured legacy levels and editor GUID permissions remain supported unless an explicit ACL denies access. GUID permission management requires both rights. Enabling/disabling selects mode 2 and saves its switch. The server console also accepts aa commands and antirush status/on/off. The loose antirush directory is installed beside the server module, outside the PK3. See docs/ANTIRUSH.md for configuration and migration.
